svg.title: Asymmetric dioxytosylation of three styrenes
svg.text: Styrene derivative (43 mM), p-toluenesulfonic acid monohydrate (86 mM), dichloromethane, −50 °C
Yields of 3 and 5 were measured by ¹H NMR with an internal standard. Geminal ditosylates 5 are achiral.
Enantiomeric excess of 3 was measured by chiral HPLC. Ts = 4-methylbenzenesulfonyl.
